calls.title: Rippling &GrowthBook | EOR Global Payroll and Time Off  with Nikhil Ramesh
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the complete setup of payroll for Canadian employees, confirming automatic processing and deadlines for salary payments. It included a review of salary components, with pension contributions linked to RRSP accounts, pending verification from the benefits team. Benefits enrollment with Manulife was finalized, ensuring synchronized deductions with payroll for transparency. A flexible PTO policy was configured, establishing a minimum statutory PTO of 10 days along with an unlimited PTO system. Compliance with Canadian holiday regulations was confirmed, and a structured post-implementation support plan was set for April 17, allowing for feedback and ongoing assistance. Jennifer’s roles in monitoring benefits and approving PTO requests were also emphasized.
calls.keywords: Canadian payroll, PTO policy, pension contributions, benefits enrollment, time off approval, post-implementation follow-up
